blocks.prompt: 8. Aliza invests Rs. 1,000,000 in a business that promises a 6% return compounded annually. Prove by mathematical induction that the amount of money after \(n\) years is \(1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^n\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rozmarra zindagi ka induction wala sawal hai. Pehle alfaaz ko ek rule (formula) mein badalna hai, phir us formula ko induction se saabit karna hai.
"6% compounded annually" ka matlab: har saal us waqt ki poori raqam par 6% munafa milta hai aur woh raqam mein jur jata hai; yani har saal raqam \(1.06\) se multiply hoti hai.
Plan: rule \(A_{k+1} = 1.06\,A_k\); pehle saal ka base case; phir rule aur hypothesis se inductive step.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: asal raqam (principal) Rs. 1,000,000; munafa 6% salana, compounded annually.
Saabit karna hai: \(S(n)\): \(n\) saal baad raqam \(A_n = 1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^n\), har positive integer \(n\) ke liye.
Tareeqa: Pehle saal-ba-saal ka rule nikalein, phir mathematical induction.

Alfaaz ko rule mein badlein
\[A_{k+1} = A_k + 0.06\,A_k\]
\[= 1.06\,A_k\]
Kyun: Har saal ke shuru mein jo raqam \(A_k\) hai, us ka 6% yani \(0.06\,A_k\) munafa milta hai, aur woh raqam mein jama ho jata hai. \(A_k\) common nikala: \(A_k(1 + 0.06) = 1.06\,A_k\). Compound ka matlab yahi hai ke agle saal ka munafa bari raqam par lagta hai.

Induction hypothesis: \(S(k)\) ko sahi maan lein
\[A_k = 1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^k \quad (A)\]
Kyun: Farz kiya ke \(k\) saal baad formula sahi raqam deta hai.

Inductive step: pehle rule, phir (A)
\[A_{k+1} = 1.06\,A_k\]
\[= 1.06 \times 1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^k\]
\[= 1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^{k+1}\]
Kyun: Saalana rule agli raqam deta hai; (A) se \(A_k\) ki jagah formula rakha; aur \(1.06^1 \times 1.06^k = 1.06^{k+1}\), kyunke same base par powers jama hoti hain.
Dhyan dein: Simple interest ki tarah har saal sirf 60,000 jama karna ghalat hai; compound mein munafa har saal barhta hai.

Conclusion
\(S(1)\) sahi hai aur \(S(k)\) se \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hota hai. Principle of mathematical induction se \(n\) saal baad raqam Rs. \(1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^n\) hai, har positive integer \(n\) ke liye.
Kyun: Induction ki dono sharten poori ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 2\)
\[1{,}060{,}000 + 63{,}600 = 1{,}123{,}600\]
\[1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^2 = 1{,}123{,}600 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre saal 1,060,000 ka 6% yani 63,600 munafa mila (pehle saal se 3,600 zyada, yahi compounding ka asar hai). Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(n\) saal baad raqam Rs. \(1{,}000{,}000(1.06)^n\) hai.
